name: rouge-1-sft-001
status: draft (not run; needs owner approval for compute and approved data)

targets: gated-deltanet input and output projections (45 linear-attention layers)
excluded: 512 routed experts (rank-64 LoRA on each would add about 7.5B trainable parameters)
vision encoder (frozen in sft-001; M66 trains multimodal)
lora.targetResolution: module names are resolved from the model's named_modules on the GPU host and recorded in the run manifest

data.requirement: only registry entries with status=approved; the mixture is rebalanced to what is approved and recorded

chatTemplate: the base's chat_template.jinja (sha256 a4aee8af...), thinking mode kept
evaluation: configs/lab-v0.json on held-out splits; compared against rouge-1-base
